speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Singularity containment confirmed. Dark-matter reactor signature zeroed. The Void Commander's command matrix has completely collapsed across all global relays.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: All imperial executive firewalls are dead. The broadcast transmitters are open to the entire planet. Look down... the quarantine sectors are dropping their barriers.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Ten million people trapped in the dark for decades... look at those lights coming online. From the lower sumps all the way to the cloudline. The city is breathing again.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: The atmospheric scrubbers are reversing. Cool ocean breezes are flowing through the shattered spire. The perpetual storm has broken.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: The eternal night is over. My solar cells are drinking in natural sunlight for the first time in fifty years. It's... warm.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: I hear their voices... not crying out in terror or silenced by suppression collars, but singing. Crying tears of joy. The resonance of a free world.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Imperial registry files across twelve districts have been erased and restored to civilian autonomy. Axiom Force mission parameters: One hundred percent achieved.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: We fought as castaways, rogues, and ghosts in the gridlock. Today, we stand as one squad. We gave them their tomorrow back.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: The dawn belongs to all of us. Axiom Force... stand down. Our city is free.
